apply_bias_to_sensor: apply a bias parameter to specified sensor columns in a timeseries
apply_gain_to_sensor: apply a gain parameter to multiply specified sensor columns in a timeseries
apply_delay_to_sensor: apply a time delay in seconds to specified sensor columns in a timeseries
resample_and_apply_delays: resample a timeseries to target timestamps with per-sensor delay compensation
compute_weighted_diff: compute the weighted difference between measured and predicted data arrays
